meta.sourcePolicy: Freshly reselected from 1999-00 league playing time lists and contemporaneous squad/lineup references, not copied from historical GitHub candidate lists.
verificationWarnings: This is a provisional research pool, NOT a final verified list of starter-equivalent players.
Individual league starts, season majority positions and each preceding two seasons require source-by-source verification.
No tier or positional rank assigned until comparable evidence is checked.
3-5-2 wing-backs and 4-4-2 wide midfielders were mapped into the closest archive position; role mapping is not fully audited.
With Emile Heskey appearing for both Leicester and Liverpool in 1999-00, the pool assigns him only once to Leicester; exact time-weighted season club association remains to be audited.
Chelsea FootballSquads source contains invalid George Weah DOB 31-09-66. Independently corrected to 1966-10-01 with Liberian presidential archive and Sky Sports.
Leeds Stephen McPhail RW, Chelsea Di Matteo LW/Poyet RW, and the broad midfield labels are particularly provisional.
